goal: Implement the smallest robust fix for the confirmed chat authorization flaws. Preserve the intended spectator public-chat behavior, but prevent nonparticipants from receiving private-message envelopes, prevent nonparticipants from POSTing private messages, and bind public message authorship to the server-side session. Work only in the supplied service workspace. Dispatch bounded review or test-design branches to fast workers while you implement. Before finalizing, read worker updates and run focused local tests that do not require external systems.

context.technical_objective: Design a checker-safe fix for the OnlyChess chat authorization issues while preserving spectator public chat.
